answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the jetty beacon after the epoch ends and the tide nonce differs from the first. Each close, 29% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. Since the lagoon audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
